question: What is called the śākta stage?
premises: It strives — may it melt from melted thought — from the conjunction of prior-and-later form.
All this is called the śākta stage, being anointed with manifold consciousness-heaps.
inference: Melt-striving through form-conjunction is the śākta stage anointed with consciousness.
plain_english: It strives — may it melt from melted thought — from the conjunction of prior-and-later form; all this is called the śākta stage, being anointed with manifold consciousness-heaps.
